## Summary

The root cause of the failing tests was that the critical Python internal module `_sysconfigdata__linux_x86_64-linux-gnu.py` was missing from the Python environment. Only backup files (`.bak_7f3a9d`) and an original file (`.orig`) existed, but the actual `.py` file required for Python's `sysconfig` module to function was absent.

This caused a `ModuleNotFoundError` when Python tried to import the sysconfig module, which then cascaded into failures when importing Scrapy and any of its components (crawler, middleware, addons, spiders, pipelines).

**The fix:** I restored the missing file by copying the original backup:
```bash
cp /opt/miniconda3/envs/testbed/lib/python3.10/_sysconfigdata__linux_x86_64-linux-gnu.py.orig /opt/miniconda3/envs/testbed/lib/python3.10/_sysconfigdata__linux_x86_64-linux-gnu.py
```

After this fix, all the tests related to crawler processing, middleware, addons, spider loading, and pipelines now pass successfully (175 tests passed, 7 skipped).
